items.title: Compare the static console demo with existing host-neutral observability requirements
items.context: Use /Users/jek/Documents/lattice-console-demo.html as the prototype input and docs/requirements/decisions/host-neutral-observability-console.md as the existing source-of-truth anchor. Identify only real productization gaps.
items.userSees: User sees heading text "Prototype Assessment" and a bullet saying the prototype hard-codes metrics while the current session_brief reports live counts.

happy.desc: The document names the static prototype input and the existing host-neutral observability source-of-truth anchor.

edge.desc: The document avoids replacing or contradicting the adopted host-neutral observability console design.

adversarial.desc: The document identifies real productization gaps instead of adding arbitrary dashboard features or cosmetic-only work.

verificationEvidence.note: The document names the static prototype input and the host-neutral observability source-of-truth anchor in its header.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "does not replace the host-neutral observability console design|Host-neutral workflow first|host-neutral and agent-neutral" docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-console-demo-mvp-requirements.md
verificationEvidence.note: The positioning statement and host-neutral principle keep this addendum from replacing or contradicting the adopted observability console design.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "No arbitrary optimization|Only fix real correctness issues|hard-coded|stale data|missing recovery instructions|unsupported JSON assumptions" docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-console-demo-mvp-requirements.md
verificationEvidence.note: The assessment and principles identify real productization gaps while rejecting arbitrary dashboard features and cosmetic-only work.

items.title: Write the Lattice Console demo MVP requirements recommendation document
items.context: Create docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-console-demo-mvp-requirements.md with goals, non-goals, data-source contracts, pages, user flows, recovery commands, authority boundaries, phased MVP, and acceptance criteria.
items.userSees: User sees heading text "Visual and Interaction Requirements" plus sections "Click Target Requirements" and "Product Logic Requirements for Clicks" in the new document.

happy.desc: The document includes goals, non-goals, CLI data-source contracts, pages, user flows, recovery commands, authority boundaries, MVP phasing, acceptance criteria, and verification plan.

edge.desc: The document explicitly requires aesthetic spacing, symmetry, minimalism, restrained hierarchy, and semantic color use.

adversarial.desc: The document explicitly requires every clickable demo target to open a meaningful detail/page/disabled explanation and preserve Lattice product logic.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "^## 4. MVP Goals|^## 5. Non-goals|^## 6. Data Source Contract|^## 7. Required Console Pages|^## 9. Core User Flows|recovery command|authority boundary|^## 10. MVP Phasing|^## 11. Acceptance Criteria|^## 12. Verification Plan" docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-console-demo-mvp-requirements.md
verificationEvidence.note: The document includes the required goals, non-goals, CLI data-source contract, pages, user flows, recovery and authority language, phasing, acceptance criteria, and verification plan.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "spacing|symmetry|minimal|restrained hierarchy|semantic color|Visual and Interaction Requirements|Aesthetic Rules|Layout Requirements" docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-console-demo-mvp-requirements.md
verificationEvidence.note: Section 8 requires aesthetic spacing, symmetry, minimalism, restrained hierarchy, semantic color, layout alignment, and visual QA.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "Click Target Requirements|Product Logic Requirements for Clicks|Every clickable element|meaningful detail|disabled-state explanation|product-logical action" docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-console-demo-mvp-requirements.md
verificationEvidence.note: Sections 8.3 and 8.4 require every clickable target to resolve and preserve Lattice product logic.

items.title: Link the new requirements recommendation from requirements navigation
items.context: If a new decision document is created, add it to docs/requirements/NAV.md so the truth-source navigation can find it.
items.userSees: User sees NAV entry "Lattice Console Demo MVP Requirements Recommendation" linking to decisions/lattice-console-demo-mvp-requirements.md.

happy.desc: NAV.md links to decisions/lattice-console-demo-mvp-requirements.md with the correct title.

edge.desc: NAV.md file count is updated consistently with the added decision document.

adversarial.desc: Navigation update is limited to the new document link and count, with no unrelated requirements navigation churn.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "Lattice Console Demo MVP Requirements Recommendation|decisions/lattice-console-demo-mvp-requirements.md" docs/requirements/NAV.md
verificationEvidence.note: NAV.md contains the correct title and link for the new requirements recommendation.
The command returned 51, matching the NAV header verified by rg -n "^> 51 个文件" docs/requirements/NAV.md.
The command produced empty output after link and count verification, so there is no unrelated NAV churn.
